$description: Reduced motion, picked by the reader's own setting through @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), never by an attribute. Every movement takes no time, so nothing travels across the screen; a change of colour or opacity keeps its time, so fades stay.

base.$description: 250ms down to 0ms: a small movement happens at once.

slow.$description: 400ms down to 0ms: a large movement happens at once.
